<thought>To design a ≤3‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target at the C=C bond (Heck coupling) and at the sulfonamide N–S bond (sulfonamide formation). This gives three commercially available precursors: benzenesulfonyl chloride, p‑toluidine, and N‑phenylacrylamide. The sulfonamide is first made, then brominated at the para position, and finally coupled with the acrylamide via a Heck reaction to afford the target. All three starting materials are inexpensive and readily purchasable, keeping the total cost well below $10 000. The retrosynthesis tree is expressed in the required JSON format.</thought>
